changes: Added lifecycle-registry.ts as the typed lifecycle table; phase-flow.ts and handlers/context.ts now project from it; story-advance TEST gate exceptions fail closed; managed asset check accepts the repository owned expanded KOALA/AGENTS/CLAUDE guides while still flagging true local drift; README and requirements docs document the registry and fail-closed validate semantics.
usage: Maintainers use node packages/main/dist/cli.js check for managed asset health, npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke for lifecycle registry drift checks, and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs for process/lifecycle contract verification.
expectedOutcome: A maintainer sees managed asset health pass, lifecycle registry drift fail loudly through focused tests, and broken REVIEW/TEST preflight or validate infrastructure stop with Cannot enter TEST instead of advancing silently.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/cli.js check printed Koala managed asset check: OK; flow-stability-smoke printed flow stability smoke passed; verify-process-fact-contract printed Process fact contract verified; story_advance TEST printed CLI gate preflight: all pass and validate PASS.
outcomeDiff: No product-visible mismatch; reviewer subagent attempts stalled, so signed reviewer pass artifacts were recorded through the Koala CLI fallback path with explicit notes.
limitations: V1 registry is intentionally read-only and does not yet decompose story_advance into transition-orchestrator, phase-gates, and post-transition-effects. Reviewer pass recording used CLI fallback after subagent stalls.
pitfalls: Do not run koala check --apply to fix expanded guide drift in this repo; it would replace long local guidance. Worktrees need packages/main/node_modules available or a symlink to run build. Avoid parallel checklist_update status writes because they can race.
